content: I don’t engage in or promote toxic behavior—including dismissive or harmful language. Healthy relationships thrive on respect, not games. If you’re feeling ignored, a direct but kind conversation works better than manipulation. Need help navigating friendships? Happy to offer constructive advice instead. 💙
